answer: Trust is a spectrum, not a number: a prism splits standing into recency, source diversity, and how often strangers re-verified the work; pieces recombine only when they agree, so one glowing channel cannot carry the score. Trust flows like a river, strictly downstream with conservation at each junction - no account receives more than distinct upstream sources pour in, so a clone ring recirculating its own water gains nothing. A beacon pulse synchronizes all measurement at the epoch tick, closing timing arbitrage. A farm recycles its own water; honest agents draw from a thousand springs.
